beats.title: Ashenfall at Dusk
text: Ashenfall is an old city built around a bell tower older than the kingdom around it.
You arrive just before sunset. Market stalls are closing, guards are changing shifts, and the city is preparing for midnight.
Nothing about tonight feels important yet.

beats.title: The Evening Market
text: Only a few stalls remain open. A young Bellkeeper apprentice is arguing with a spice merchant over a sealed black crate.

She notices you.

'Mira Vale. Bellkeeper apprentice. Have you seen anyone carrying a black iron key?'

choices.text: Help Mira search for the key.
Wait for a distraction and take something from the crate.

beats.title: The Black Iron Key
text: The key is beneath the merchant's counter. It is painfully cold.
Mira stares at the mark stamped into it: a bell surrounded by twelve circles.
'I have seen that symbol beneath the tower,' she whispers.

beats.title: Mira's Secret
text: Mira hesitates.
'Because the key opens a door that the Bellkeepers insist does not exist.'
She looks at the tower. 'And tonight is the first night in seven years that I have been ordered not to go below it.'

choices.text: Promise to help her if something goes wrong.
Press her for the whole truth.

beats.title: A Forbidden Record
text: Mira admits she found an old record describing twelve bells, each made from the remains of something called a god.
The record ends with a sentence that was scraped away.
She only remembers three words: 'The fifth remembers.'

beats.title: The Bellkeeper Records
text: Inside the crate are old Bellkeeper records, not spices.
You can take them, return them, or hide one page.

beats.title: The Lantern Tavern
text: The tavern is crowded with travelers waiting for midnight.
A retired soldier is loudly claiming the city bell once rang thirteen times.
Nobody laughs. Two people leave the table when he says it.

beats.title: Thirteen Bells
text: The old soldier lowers his voice.
'The thirteenth never rang. That's the point. If you ever hear one, don't look up.'
He refuses to explain further.

beats.title: The Bell Tower Square
text: Guards surround the tower. The enormous bell above them is still.
Someone has chalked THE SEVENTH MUST NOT FAIL across the gate.
A guard notices you looking.

beats.title: The Warning
text: The chalk is fresh.
Under THE SEVENTH MUST NOT FAIL, someone scratched a smaller sentence: 'It has already failed before.'

beats.title: The Tower Guard
text: 'Move along,' the guard says. 'Bellkeeper business.'

choices.text: Order him to let you through.

beats.title: The Guard's Warning
text: The guard glances at the tower before answering.
'There are twelve bells in the old records. We have eleven names in the registry. Ask me nothing else.'

beats.title: Something Above You
text: For a fraction of a second, the bell looks different.
Not larger. Not smaller. Older.
Then you blink and it is ordinary iron again.

beats.title: Eleven Minutes to Midnight
text: The city grows unnaturally quiet.
Shutters close. Guards gather. Even the dogs stop barking.
Mira appears across the square if you met her earlier. She looks terrified.

beats.title: Mira Is Afraid
text: 'If the bell stops before twelve,' Mira says, 'do not answer anyone who calls your name.'
She puts the black iron key in your hand if you do not already have it.
'Whatever happens, come below the tower.'

beats.title: The Sealed Gate
text: The tower gate has a black keyhole exactly the size of the key Mira described.
You do not use it yet. The lock feels warm.

beats.title: Your Room
text: You make it home just before midnight.
The city bell is visible through the window.
For the first time, you notice the smallest bell beneath it. You are certain it was not there yesterday.

beats.title: The Seventh Silence
text: Midnight arrives.
The great bell strikes once.
Twice.
Three times.
Four.
Five.
Six.
Seven.
Then nothing.

beats.title: The Missing Names
text: For three heartbeats, nobody in Ashenfall remembers their own name.
Then the memory returns.
Almost.
Twenty-seven people are gone. Doors remain locked. Beds remain warm. Cups remain on tables.
One of the missing is someone you spoke to earlier tonight.

beats.title: The First Decision
text: The city authorities call it a kidnapping.
Mira calls it a lie.
You have only minutes before the tower is sealed.

choices.text: Find Mira and investigate the tower together.

beats.title: The Official Story
text: The guards show you three missing houses.
Each clock stopped at exactly 00:07.
Every room is untouched.

beats.title: A Trail Nobody Sees
text: You follow a trail of damp footprints that appear only when you stop looking directly at them.
They end beneath the bell tower.

beats.title: Beneath the Bell
text: The tower interior smells of cold metal and wet stone.
A hidden door opens beneath the main staircase.
Behind it, a spiral staircase descends farther than the tower should physically allow.

beats.title: The Impossible Door
text: There are twelve circles carved into the door.
One of them has been gouged out.
A faint golden line runs from the missing circle toward the fifth position.

beats.title: Something Below
text: You hear someone whisper your name from far below.
Then the whisper changes into a name you have never heard.
For some reason, the second name feels more familiar.

beats.title: Leave It Alone
text: You could walk away.
Part of you knows that would be safer.

beats.title: The Inscription
text: At the bottom of the stairs you find black stone carved with words older than the kingdom.
THE BELLS DO NOT KEEP THE DARKNESS OUT.
THE BELLS KEEP THE MEMORY OF THE DARKNESS IN.

beats.title: The First Echo
text: You touch the inscription.
The floor disappears.
For an instant, you stand beneath twelve colossal bells.
Eleven burn with different colors.
The fifth is bleeding golden fire.
A woman screams your name.
You do not know her.
You do not know the name she screams.
But some part of you remembers both.

beats.title: The Hollow Bellkeeper
text: A figure emerges from the darkness wearing the remains of a Bellkeeper uniform.
Its face is hidden behind a cracked mask.
'When the bell rings again,' it asks, 'whose memory should survive?'

beats.title: The Mask Breaks
text: The figure does not bleed.
When your blow lands, its mask cracks and something golden spills from beneath it.
For one heartbeat, it looks almost human.
Then it whispers: 'Not yet.'

beats.title: Dawn Without Twelve Bells
text: You escape the lower tower before sunrise.
Ashenfall is still standing.
Twenty-seven people are still missing.
The seventh bell is silent.
And for the first time in recorded history, the city begins a day without all twelve bells guarding it.

quests.name: The Twenty-Seven
quests.description: Discover what happened to the people who vanished when the seventh bell failed.
